## 6.1 1538TE10H11 vs 1538TE10HE13

Are there progenitor and neuronal output differences across time in the dorsal MGE one day after tamoxifen

```{r}

library(Seurat)
library(Signac)
library(GenomicRanges)
library(EnsDb.Mmusculus.v79)
library(BSgenome.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10)
library(patchwork)
library(ggplot2)
library(cowplot)
library(DT)
library(tidyverse)
library(glmGamPoi)
library(future)
library(scCustomize)
library(SeuratWrappers)
library(monocle3)


metadata <- read.csv("metadata_Jia_1058_1538_CreER.csv")


# 1538TE10H11
d1 <- readRDS(paste0("./Clustered Seurat objects/", "1538CreTE10HE11MGE", "_QCed_clustered_Seurat.RDS"))

# 1538TE10HE13 - a subset of MGE POA and Septum cells  
d2 <- readRDS(paste0("Clustered Seurat objects/", "1538CreTE10HE13_Pool22_MGE_QCed_clustered_Seurat.RDS"))    


# Add dataset IDs
d1$dataset <- "1538TE10H11"
d2$dataset <- "1538TE10HE13"


# Create a list of objects and merge metadata 
ifnb.list <- list(d1, d2)


gc()

# Check the number of cells. If few cells are present adjust the k.weight parameter accordingly.

sapply(ifnb.list, function(x) ncol(x))



plan("multicore", workers = 4) # Decrease the number of cores if running out of memory or "Error 2 (The system cannot find the file specified)" ?? I'm not sure what this error means, but it's triggered by FindIntegrationAnchors.

options(future.globals.maxSize = 30000 * 1024^2) # for 30 Gb RAM

features <- SelectIntegrationFeatures(object.list = ifnb.list, nfeatures = 3000) # originally 3000
ifnb.list <- PrepSCTIntegration(object.list = ifnb.list, anchor.features = features)


RNA.anchors <- FindIntegrationAnchors(object.list = ifnb.list, 
                                         normalization.method = "SCT",
                                         anchor.features = features)

# k.weight adjustment: https://github.com/satijalab/seurat/issues/3930
RNA_integrated <- IntegrateData(anchorset = RNA.anchors, 
                                normalization.method = "SCT",
                                k.weight = 100)

RNA_integrated <- RunPCA(RNA_integrated, verbose = TRUE, npcs = 30)

source("data_dims_simple.R")
data_dims_scree(RNA_integrated)

PCs = 25 # Determined empirically

pbmc <- RNA_integrated
rm(RNA_integrated)

pbmc <- RunPCA(pbmc, verbose = FALSE, npcs = PCs)
pbmc <- RunUMAP(pbmc, dims = 1:PCs, verbose = FALSE)

# Recluster
pbmc <- FindNeighbors(pbmc, dims = 1:PCs, verbose = FALSE)
pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc, verbose = FALSE, graph.name = "integrated_snn")



DimPlot(pbmc)

DimPlot(pbmc, split.by = "dataset")

```


DE between datasets all cells in one dataset vs the other

```{r, eval=FALSE}

id1 <- rownames(filter(pbmc@meta.data, dataset == "1538TE10H11"))
id2 <- rownames(filter(pbmc@meta.data, dataset == "1538TE10HE13"))

DefaultAssay(pbmc) <- "SCT"
plan("multisession", workers = 1)

pbmc <- PrepSCTFindMarkers(pbmc)
DE_genes <- FindMarkers(pbmc, ident.1 = id1, ident.2 = id2, min.pct = 0.25, logfc.threshold = 0.25)


DE_signature_genes <- rownames(DE_genes)[DE_genes$p_val_adj < 0.05 & DE_genes$avg_log2FC > 1 | DE_genes$avg_log2FC < -1]

write.csv(DE_genes, file = "./DE_signatures/1st_comparison_1538TE10H11_vs_1538TE10HE13_Wilcoxon_min.pct_0.25_logfc_025.csv")


```

Count cell types:
```{r}

# Count cell types

library(tidyverse)
df <- pbmc@meta.data


cluster_split <- df %>%
  group_by(customclassif_cl, dataset) %>%
  summarize(n = n()) %>% 
  spread(dataset, n)  

colnames(cluster_split) <- c("customclassif_cl", "Counts_1538TE10H11", "Counts_1538TE10HE13")

df <- as.data.frame(cluster_split)

df[,2] <- ifelse(is.na(df[,2]), 0, df[,2])
df[,3] <- ifelse(is.na(df[,3]), 0, df[,3])


df$Prop_1538TE10H11 <- round(df[,2] / sum(df[,2]), 3)
df$Prop_1538TE10HE13 <- round(df[,3] / sum(df[,3]), 3)

df$log_Prop_ratio <- round(log2(df$Prop_1538TE10H11 / df$Prop_1538TE10HE13), 2)
    
    
```

Pseudotime:
```{r}

library(SeuratWrappers)
library(monocle3)
library(Seurat)

DefaultAssay(pbmc) <- "RNA"
cds <- as.cell_data_set(pbmc)

# to get cell metadata 
#colData(cds)

# to get metadata
#fData(cds)
#rownames(fData(cds))[1:10]
fData(cds)$gene_short_name <- rownames(fData(cds))

# to get counts
#counts(cds)

# Cluster cells using clustering infor from Seurat's UMAP

# Assign partitions
reacreate.partition <- c(rep(1,length(cds@colData@rownames))) # Only 1 partition here
names(reacreate.partition) <- cds@colData@rownames
reacreate.partition <- as.factor(reacreate.partition)

cds@clusters$UMAP$partitions <- reacreate.partition


# Assign Seurat clusters
list_cluster <- pbmc@active.ident
cds@clusters$UMAP$clusters <- list_cluster

# Assign UMAP coordinate - cell embeddings
cds@int_colData@listData$reducedDims$UMAP <- pbmc@reductions$umap@cell.embeddings


cluster_before_trajectory <- plot_cells(cds, color_cells_by = "cluster",
           label_groups_by_cluster = FALSE,
           group_label_size = 5)+
    theme(legend.position = "right")




# For scType annotation
 cluster_names <- plot_cells(cds, color_cells_by = "customclassif_cl",
           label_groups_by_cluster = FALSE,
           group_label_size = 5)+
    theme(legend.position = "right")


cluster_before_trajectory | cluster_names


# Learn trajectory graph
cds <- learn_graph(cds, use_partition = FALSE)



trajectory <- plot_cells(cds, color_cells_by = "customclassif_cl",
           label_groups_by_cluster = FALSE,
           label_branch_points = FALSE,
           label_roots = FALSE,
           label_leaves = FALSE,
           group_label_size = 5)


cluster_before_trajectory | trajectory
```

## DE between neuronal and progenitor markers 

```{r}

progenitors <- rownames(filter(pbmc@meta.data, seurat_clusters %in% c(6, 0, 7, 5, 4, 10)))
#interneurons <- 
neurons <- rownames(filter(pbmc@meta.data, seurat_clusters %in% c(2,3)))


DefaultAssay(pbmc) <- "SCT"
plan("multisession", workers = 1)

pbmc <- PrepSCTFindMarkers(pbmc)
DE_genes <- FindMarkers(pbmc, ident.1 = progenitors, ident.2 = neurons, min.pct = 0.25, logfc.threshold = 0.25)


DE_signature_genes <- rownames(DE_genes)[DE_genes$p_val_adj < 0.05 & DE_genes$avg_log2FC > 1 | DE_genes$avg_log2FC < -1]

write.csv(DE_genes, file = "./DE_signatures/1st_comparison_Neurons_vs_progenitors_Wilcoxon_min.pct_0.25_logfc_025.csv")


```

########################

```{r}

markers_df <- read.csv(paste0("./DE_signatures/Integrated_cluster_markers_1st_comparison_1538TE10H11_vs_1538TE10HE13_Wilcoxon_min.pct_0.25_logfc_025.csv"))


last_cluster <- max(as.numeric(as.character(pbmc@meta.data$seurat_clusters)))

 call_markers <- function(markers_df){
    
        markers <- lapply(0:last_cluster, function(x){
        
            dplyr::filter(markers_df, 
                      p_val_adj < 0.1, 
                      avg_log2FC > 0,
                      cluster == x)[1:50, "gene"]
    })
    
        markers <- do.call(cbind, markers)
        colnames(markers) <- paste0("Cluster_", 0:last_cluster)
        markers <- as.data.frame(markers)
        markers
    
    }

 
top_markers_Wilcoxon_full <- call_markers(markers_df)
top_markers_Wilcoxon_full <- top_markers_Wilcoxon_full[1:15,]


# Count the number of non NA gene markers across cell clusters.
non_NAs <- as.numeric(sapply(top_markers_Wilcoxon_full, function(y) sum(length(which(!is.na(y))))))


##########################################################################

top_cluster_genes <- function(cluster, n_top_genes){
    
    DefaultAssay(pbmc) <- "SCT"
    
    gc(verbose = FALSE)
    try(dev.off(), silent = TRUE)
    
    FeaturePlot(pbmc, features = top_markers_Wilcoxon_full[1:n_top_genes, cluster], 
                reduction = 'umap', max.cutoff = 15, ncol = 5)&
        labs(x = "", y = "")&
        NoLegend()&
        plot_annotation(title = paste0("Cluster: ", cluster -1), 
                        theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16, face = "bold")))
}

# Plot 15 genes for each cluster, which does not contain only NAs. 
# If contains NAs, plot the allowed number. 

pl <- lapply(which(non_NAs > 0), function(x){
        
        try(top_cluster_genes(x, non_NAs[x]))
        
        })

names(pl) <- paste0("Cluster_", c(which(non_NAs > 0) - 1))


# Create output directory
try(dir.create(paste0("1st_comparison", "_feature_plots")))



# Export png plots
lapply(1:length(pl), function(y){
    
    lapply(pl[y], function(x){ggsave(plot = x,
                              filename = paste0("1st_comparison", "_feature_plots", "/", names(pl)[y], ".png"), 
                              
                              device = "png", width = 14, height = 9, dpi = 300)
        }
        )
    }
)

```


# Rescue cells 1538 MGE cells from a MULTI-seq experiment, ignoring poorly performing LMO barcodes, and filtering out cells originating from POA, and Septum using cell markers.

Original analysis including demultiplexing: G:\Shared drives\Nord Lab - Computational Projects\DLXP01
```{r}

    # Load RNA counts
    counts <- Read10X("G:/Shared drives/Nord Lab - Computational Projects/DLXP01/CellRanger_outs/122220_1538Cre/filtered_feature_bc_matrix")
    
    # Create a Seurat object containing the RNA data
    pbmc <- CreateSeuratObject(
        counts = counts,
        assay = "RNA"
    )
    
    # Check names of the mitochondrial genes
    # rownames(pbmc)[grepl("^mt-", rownames(pbmc), ignore.case = TRUE)]
    
    # Mitochondrial genes: 
    DefaultAssay(pbmc) <- "RNA"
    pbmc[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(pbmc, pattern = "^mt-")
    
    # Violin plot - pre-filtering        
    p1 <- VlnPlot(
        object = pbmc,
        features = c("nCount_RNA", "nFeature_RNA", "percent.mt"),
        ncol = 3,
        pt.size = 0.1)& 
        theme(axis.text.x = element_blank())&
        plot_annotation(title = paste0("Cellranger filtered cells.", " Features: ", nrow(pbmc),
                                       " Cells: ", ncol(pbmc)), 
                        theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16, face = "bold")))
    
    
    p3 <- ggplot(pbmc@meta.data, aes(x = log2(nFeature_RNA),  y = log(nCount_RNA)))+
        geom_point(alpha = 0.2)+
        theme_bw()+
        labs(title = "Cellranger filtered cells")
    
    
    
    
    # Define QC filtering thresholds using 3 median absolute deviations. 
    # This idea borrowed from the scater package
    
    mad_distance = 5
    
    count_threshold_high <- median(pbmc@meta.data$nCount_RNA) + mad_distance*mad(pbmc@meta.data$nCount_RNA)
    features_threshold_high <- median(pbmc@meta.data$nFeature_RNA) + mad_distance*mad(pbmc@meta.data$nFeature_RNA)
    mito_threshold_high <- median(pbmc@meta.data$percent.mt) + mad_distance*mad(pbmc@meta.data$percent.mt)
    
    
    ## Filter out low quality cells
    pbmc <- subset(
        x = pbmc,
        subset =
            #nCount_RNA < count_threshold_high &
            nCount_RNA > 1000 &
            #nFeature_RNA < features_threshold_high &  
            #nFeature_RNA > 200 &
            percent.mt < 20 
    )
    
    
    # Violin plot - post-filtering    
    p2 <- VlnPlot(
        object = pbmc,
        features = c("nCount_RNA", "nFeature_RNA", "percent.mt"),
        ncol = 3,
        pt.size = 0.1)& 
        theme(axis.text.x = element_blank())&
        plot_annotation(title = paste0("Quality filtered cells.", " Features: ", nrow(pbmc),
                                       " Cells: ", ncol(pbmc)), 
                        theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16, face = "bold")))
    
    
    p4 <- ggplot(pbmc@meta.data, aes(x = log2(nFeature_RNA),  y = log(nCount_RNA)))+
        geom_point(alpha = 0.1)+
        theme_bw()+
        labs(title = "Quality filtered cells")
    
    
    
    # Save post filtering object    
saveRDS(pbmc, file = paste0("./QCed Seurat objects/", "MGE_POA_Septum_1538_Pool22_1681cells", "_QCed_Seurat_obj.rds"))
    
    
   top <-  plot_grid(p1, p2, ncol = 1)
    
   bottom <- plot_grid(p3, p4, ncol = 2)
   
   plot_grid(top, bottom, ncol = 1)
```

# Integrate

```{r}

metadata <- read.csv("metadata_Jia_1058_1538_CreER.csv")

# 1538TE10H11
d1 <- readRDS(paste0("./Clustered Seurat objects/", "1538CreTE10HE11MGE", "_QCed_clustered_Seurat.RDS"))

# 1538TE10HE13 - a subset of MGE POA and Septum cells  
d2 <- readRDS(paste0("./QCed Seurat objects/", "MGE_POA_Septum_1538_Pool22_1681cells", "_QCed_Seurat_obj.rds"))    
d2 <- SCTransform(d2, method = "glmGamPoi", verbose = FALSE)


# Add dataset IDs
d1$dataset <- "1538TE10H11"
d2$dataset <- "1538TE10HE13"


# Create a list of objects and merge metadata 
ifnb.list <- list(d1, d2)


gc()

# Check the number of cells. If few cells are present adjust the k.weight parameter accordingly.

sapply(ifnb.list, function(x) ncol(x))



plan("multicore", workers = 1) # Decrease the number of cores if running out of memory or "Error 2 (The system cannot find the file specified)" ?? I'm not sure what this error means, but it's triggered by FindIntegrationAnchors.

options(future.globals.maxSize = 30000 * 1024^2) # for 30 Gb RAM

features <- SelectIntegrationFeatures(object.list = ifnb.list, nfeatures = 3000) # originally 3000
ifnb.list <- PrepSCTIntegration(object.list = ifnb.list, anchor.features = features)


RNA.anchors <- FindIntegrationAnchors(object.list = ifnb.list, 
                                         normalization.method = "SCT",
                                         anchor.features = features)

# k.weight adjustment: https://github.com/satijalab/seurat/issues/3930
RNA_integrated <- IntegrateData(anchorset = RNA.anchors, 
                                normalization.method = "SCT",
                                k.weight = 100)

RNA_integrated <- RunPCA(RNA_integrated, verbose = TRUE, npcs = 30)

source("data_dims_simple.R")
data_dims_scree(RNA_integrated)

PCs = 25 # Determined empirically

pbmc <- RNA_integrated
rm(RNA_integrated)

pbmc <- RunPCA(pbmc, verbose = FALSE, npcs = PCs)
pbmc <- RunUMAP(pbmc, dims = 1:PCs, verbose = FALSE)

# Recluster
pbmc <- FindNeighbors(pbmc, dims = 1:PCs, verbose = FALSE)
pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc, verbose = FALSE, graph.name = "integrated_snn")

DimPlot(pbmc)

DimPlot(pbmc, split.by = "dataset")
```

## Update June 12th 2023.

* POA genes - Igfbp5 (positive in POA), Dbx1 (positive in POA), Hmx3 (positive in POA) - genes specifically expressed in POA. Cells must be negative for all 3 to be considered as non POA.

* Septum - Spry1 (positive in Septum), Fgf8 (positive in Septum) - Cells need to be negative for both.

* MGE progenitor cells need to be positive for Gsx2 and Olig2. Some Olig2 is expressed in septum, but that shouldn't be used as a criterion for excluding cells.


* Single genes are not necessarily captured well by single cell data. Inclusion or exclusion criteria shouldn't be based on single genes. 

    ** Make a slide demonstrating the expression of these genes.
    
* Dissections aren't perfect, and some septum cells migrate to MGE. 

* Neuronal markers: Hes1 (MGE VZ), Ascl1 (MGE SVZ), Gad1 (Mantle zone neurons) 

To Do list:

* 1. To do: Discover septum cell markers and Septum cells? DE for Spry1 & Fgf8 pos vs neg to identify other markers. This may find more Septum markers. 
* 2. Progenitors within ages: Hes1 (VZ) vs Ascl1 (SVZ) for each age separately. 
* 3. Progenitors vs Neurons within ages: Ascl1 (SVZ) vs Gad1 (Mantle zone).
* 4. VZ cells between ages, E11 vs E13, using Hes1 to mark VZ.
* 5. SVZ cells between ages, Ascl1 positive & Hes1 negative.
* 6. Mantle zone Gad1 positive vs Hes1 and Ascl1 negative.

* More detailed analysis
* Assign cell cycle.  
* 7. Many cell fate decisions in the MGE progenitors are made in the G1. E11 vs E13. Mcm5 (G1/S) positive, and likewise for Aurka (G2/M) positive cells. DE between timepoints for the progenitors in the G1/S and G2/M.
* 8. Radial glia (Nes positive) E11 vs E13. At E13 they start to express Dlx1. 
* 9. Subcluster Zic1 and Ggx1 cells - they have overlapping expression in the brain. Shaved vs divergent between two clusters. Positive for Zic1, positive for Gbx1, and positive for both. Jia expects these populations to be different .

```{r}
######
# When identifying cells expressing a particular gene, 
# the quant parameter sets the minimum quantile of non-zero gene distribution for considering a gene to be expressed in a cell. 

cells_expressing_gene <- function(gene, quant){
    
    expr <- pbmc@assays$SCT@data[rownames(pbmc@assays$SCT@data) %in% gene,]
    
    # Remove 0s
    expr <- expr[expr > 0]
    
    # Keeping only the top 20% of the gene distribution% ?? 
    expr <- expr[expr > quantile(expr, quant)]
    
    names(expr)
    
    }

#####

POA_cells <- unique(c(cells_expressing_gene("Igfbp5", 0.8),
                      cells_expressing_gene("Dbx1", 0.8),
```

Train SVM to detect POA cells
```{r}

# Backup data:
#load("G:/Shared drives/Nord Lab - Computational #Projects2/Jia_1056_1538_CreER/Temp_workspace_7_17_2023.RData")

# Based on the tutorial here: https://bioconductor.org/packages/release/bioc/vignettes/scAnnotatR/inst/doc/training-basic-model.html

POA_markers <- c("Igfbp5" ,"Dbx1" ,"Hmx3")

#BiocManager::install("scAnnotatR")
library("scAnnotatR")

# Add POA cell annotation - preclassified cells, based on the "Igfbp5" ,"Dbx1" ,"Hmx3" expression.
pbmc@meta.data$Most_likely_cell_type <- ifelse(Cells(pbmc) %in% POA_cells, "POA", "MGE")


# The original tutorial was splitting the data, but was not sampling it randomly. 
# It's not ideal because datasets are ordered sequentially in the Seurat object.

# Pivot point - not exactly a pivot point of for splitting. Just a halfpoint of the data.
pivot = ncol(pbmc)%/%2

set.seed(1234)
sampling_vector <- sample(x = 1:ncol(pbmc),
                          size = pivot, 
                          replace = FALSE)


train_set <- pbmc[, sampling_vector]
test_set <- pbmc[, setdiff(1:ncol(pbmc), sampling_vector)]


# I'm building the model on RNA counts instead of SCT normnalized data here.
# When using RNA counts, the model detects fewer cells due to deemphasis of low values in the matrix 

classifier_POA <- train_classifier(train_obj = train_set,
                                 tag_slot = "Most_likely_cell_type",
                                 cell_type = "POA", 
                                 marker_genes = POA_markers,
                                 assay = 'RNA')


classifier_POA
caret_model(classifier_POA)



classifier_POA_test <- test_classifier(classifier = classifier_POA, 
                                       test_obj = test_set,  
                                       assay = 'RNA', 
                                       tag_slot = 'Most_likely_cell_type')


classifier_POA_test # Area under the curve: 0.9817

roc_curve <- plot_roc_curve(test_result = classifier_POA_test)
plot(roc_curve)  # AUC = 0.9817


###

classifier_POA_total <- test_classifier(classifier = classifier_POA, 
                                       test_obj = pbmc,  
                                       assay = 'RNA', 
                                       tag_slot = 'Most_likely_cell_type')


classifier_POA@caret_model

roc_curve <- plot_roc_curve(test_result = classifier_POA_total)
plot(roc_curve)  # AUC = 0.98


table(classifier_POA_total$pred$class)


DimPlot(pbmc, cells.highlight = POA_cells, split.by = "dataset")


# 728 POA cells
DimPlot(pbmc, 
        cells.highlight = rownames(filter(classifier_POA_total$pred, class == 1)), 
        split.by = "dataset")



table(classifier_POA_total$pred$class)


pbmc@meta.data$SVM_cell_type <- ifelse(
    Cells(pbmc) %in% rownames(filter(classifier_POA_total$pred, class == 1)), "POA", "MGE")
```

## Septum cells and putative markers

```{r}

# https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC8694698/
# Nes - radial glia
# Ascl1 - intermediate progenitors
# Dcx - newborn neurons
# Lhx6 - MGE/PoA-derived neurons 
# Gbx2 - newborn cholinergic neurons
# Dner - general marker for septal neurons
# Tbr1 - pallium-derived neurons
# Trp73 - Cajal-Retzius cells
# Isl1 <- LGE-derived neurons expressing
# Prkcd -  potential LS marker gene
# Zic4  - general septal marker (Rubin et al., 2010)
# 

DimPlot(pbmc)
```

## Recluster

Work zone
```{r}

# Rerun the integration pipeline to insure that all object slots are updated

# Add dataset IDs
#d1$dataset <- "1538TE10H11"
#d2$dataset <- "1538TE10HE13"

setwd("G:/Shared drives/Nord Lab - Computational Projects2/Jia_1056_1538_CreER")
#pbmc <- readRDS("./Seurat_objects/MGE_without_POA_and_Septum_H11_and_H13_7_20_2023.Rds")


d1 <- subset(pbmc, dataset == "1538TE10H11")
d2 <- subset(pbmc, dataset == "1538TE10HE13")

#d1 <- RunPCA(d1)
#d2 <- RunPCA(d2)

# Create a list of objects and merge metadata 
ifnb.list <- list(d1, d2)

ifnb.list <- lapply(X = ifnb.list, FUN = SCTransform)
features <- SelectIntegrationFeatures(object.list = ifnb.list, nfeatures = 3000)
ifnb.list <- PrepSCTIntegration(object.list = ifnb.list, anchor.features = features)


gc()

# Check the number of cells. If few cells are present adjust the k.weight parameter accordingly.
sapply(ifnb.list, function(x) ncol(x))


plan("multicore", workers = 1) # Decrease the number of cores if running out of memory or "Error 2 (The system cannot find the file specified)" ?? I'm not sure what this error means, but it's triggered by FindIntegrationAnchors.

options(future.globals.maxSize = 30000 * 1024^2) # for 30 Gb RAM

RNA.anchors <- FindIntegrationAnchors(object.list = ifnb.list, 
                                         normalization.method = "SCT",
                                         anchor.features = features)

# k.weight adjustment: https://github.com/satijalab/seurat/issues/3930
RNA_integrated <- IntegrateData(anchorset = RNA.anchors, 
                                normalization.method = "SCT",
                                k.weight = 100)

RNA_integrated <- RunPCA(RNA_integrated, verbose = TRUE, npcs = 30)

source("data_dims_simple.R")
data_dims_scree(RNA_integrated)

PCs = 25 # Determined empirically

pbmc <- RNA_integrated
rm(RNA_integrated)

pbmc <- RunPCA(pbmc, verbose = FALSE, npcs = PCs)
pbmc <- RunUMAP(pbmc, dims = 1:PCs, verbose = FALSE)

# Recluster
pbmc <- FindNeighbors(pbmc, dims = 1:PCs, verbose = FALSE)
pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc, verbose = FALSE, graph.name = "integrated_snn")

DimPlot(pbmc)

DimPlot(pbmc, split.by = "dataset", label = TRUE, label.size = 8, pt.size = 1.1)
```

# H11 vs H13 VZ progenitors

## Using Hes1 expression to guide cell selection

### VZ H11 vs H13 - Top priority

Using Hes1 as the marker and robust rank aggregation

```{r}


cells_expressing_gene2 <- function(gene, dataset_name, bottom_trim){
  
    expr <- pbmc@assays$SCT@data[rownames(pbmc@assays$SCT@data) %in% gene,]
    
    # Remove 0s
    expr <- expr[expr > 0]
    
    # Filter cells in a data set
    expr <- expr[names(expr) %in% rownames(dplyr::filter(pbmc@meta.data, dataset == dataset_name))]
    
    
    # Removing bottom X%  of non 0 distribution, per dataset, to reduce noise 
    expr <- expr[expr >= quantile(expr, bottom_trim)]
    
    # Print a vector of cell names
    names(expr)
    
    # earlier version had dataset filtering after quantile thresholding.
    # pbmc@meta.data$cell_name <- rownames(pbmc@meta.data) 
    # rownames(dplyr::filter(pbmc@meta.data, cell_name %in% names(expr) & dataset == dataset_name))
    
    }


```

## VZ (Hes1) vs SVZ (Ascl1) cells at H13

```{r}

setwd("G:/Shared drives/Nord Lab - Computational Projects2/Jia_1056_1538_CreER")


pbmc <- PrepSCTFindMarkers(pbmc)

# In which rank positions are Hes1 and Ascl1 markers? 
# The percentile sweep ranging from 0 to 0.9 resulted in Hes1 always being in the 1st rank, but Ascl1 was at the 755th position for the 1st 8 iterations. That's why I change the range of the percentile sweep from 0.4 to 0.9. This resulted in Ascl1 landing at the 7th or 2nd position across 11 DE comparisons. Increasing the scringency for Ascl1 is justified because its expression is very broad at H13, and therefore not very restricted to SVZ cells before thresholding. 


gene_ranks <- sapply(seq(0.5, 0.90, 0.05), function(trim_val){
    
    VZ_cells_H13 <- cells_expressing_gene2("Hes1", 
                                           dataset = "1538TE10HE13", 
                                           bottom_trim = trim_val)
    
    SVZ_cells_H13 <- cells_expressing_gene2("Ascl1", 
                                            dataset = "1538TE10HE13", 
                                            bottom_trim = trim_val)


    markers <- FindMarkers(pbmc, ident.1 = VZ_cells_H13,
                                 ident.2 = SVZ_cells_H13, 
                                    min.pct = 0.25, 
                                    logfc.threshold = 0.25,
                                    only.pos = FALSE)

    rownames(markers)

})

    cbind(x)
    })
```

```{r}
### Collapse to gene ranks
collapse_to_gene_ranks <- function(DE_list){
    
    # This cbind implementation turns the recycling off. 
    maxlength <- max(unlist(lapply(DE_list, length)))

    ranked_genes <- sapply(DE_list, function(x){
    
        length(x) <- maxlength
        cbind(x)
        })


    colnames(ranked_genes) <- paste0("Quant_cut_", seq(0, 0.90, 0.05))
    
    ranked_genes

}
```

```{r}
#colnames(anno) <- "seurat_clusters"


anno$seurat_clusters <- factor(anno$seurat_clusters, levels = 0:16) 

d2 <- lapply(c(0, 1, 4, 5, 10, 8, 16,
               14, 12, 11, 7,
               9, 6, 3, 13, 2, 15), function(x){
    
    cells <- rownames(filter(anno, seurat_clusters == x))
    as.data.frame(d)[, cells]
    
    })

d2 <- do.call(cbind, d2)


library(pheatmap)

# Regulatr SCT expression heatmap
#pheatmap(d,
#         fontsize_row = 5,
#         show_rownames = T,
#         scale = "row", 
#         labels_col = F,
#         cluster_cols = T,
#         clustering_distance_rows = "correlation",
#         clustering_distance_cols = "correlation",
#         method = "average",    
#         color = rev(myColor),
#         annotation_col = anno)


# Z Scaling
d3 <- t(scale(t(d2)))

d3 <- ifelse(d3 > 3, 3, d3)
d3 <- ifelse(d3 < -3, -3, d3)

pheatmap(d3,
         fontsize_row = 5,
         show_rownames = T,
         fontsize = 7,    
         #scale = "row", 
         labels_col = F,
         cluster_cols = F,
         clustering_distance_rows = "correlation",
         clustering_distance_cols = "correlation",
         method = "average",    
         color = rev(myColor),
         annotation_col = anno)

```


## H11 SVZ markers
```{r}

# Cluster genes
# using both datasets
d <- subset(pbmc, dataset %in% c("1538TE10H11"))@assays$SCT@counts
d <- d[rownames(d) %in% x$SVZ_H11, ]
d <- as.matrix(d)


paletteLength <- 100
test <- as.matrix(d)

myBreaks <- c(seq(min(test), 0, length.out=ceiling(paletteLength/2) + 1), 
              seq(max(test)/paletteLength, max(test), length.out=floor(paletteLength/2)))

myColor <- colorRampPalette(c("#9E0041", "#fea11d","#fea11d", 
                              "white", 
                              "#43abea", "#0a48aa", "#13008e"))(paletteLength)

# Cluster annotation
anno <- subset(pbmc, dataset %in% c("1538TE10H11"))@meta.data
anno <- as.data.frame(anno[,c("dataset", "seurat_clusters", "Region")])
#colnames(anno) <- "seurat_clusters"


anno$seurat_clusters <- factor(anno$seurat_clusters, levels = 0:16) 

d2 <- lapply(c(0, 1, 4, 5, 10, 8, 16,
               14, 12, 11, 7,
               9, 6, 3, 13, 2, 15), function(x){
    
    cells <- rownames(filter(anno, seurat_clusters == x))
    as.data.frame(d)[, cells]
    
    })

d2 <- do.call(cbind, d2)

library(pheatmap)


pheatmap(d, 
         scale = "row", 
         labels_col = F,
         cluster_cols = T,
         clustering_distance_rows = "correlation",
         clustering_distance_cols = "correlation",
         method = "average",    
         color = rev(myColor),
         annotation_col = anno)


# Z Scaling
d3 <- t(scale(t(d2)))

d3 <- ifelse(d3 > 3, 3, d3)
d3 <- ifelse(d3 < -3, -3, d3)

pheatmap(d3,
         fontsize = 10,    
         #scale = "row", 
         labels_col = F,
         cluster_cols = F,
         clustering_distance_rows = "correlation",
         clustering_distance_cols = "correlation",
         method = "average",    
         color = rev(myColor),
         annotation_col = anno)


```
